verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trello has a REST API reference covering sections such as Batch, Search and Webhooks, plus guides on API keys and authorization. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or executable requests. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec to drive an interactive explorer; a static reference alone counts only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
